question: Should this ClawHub issue remain as a cross-repo routing record, be migrated to the OpenClaw runtime/browser tracker, or be closed only after a canonical runtime issue exists?
rationale: The report is detailed and plausibly actionable, but the relevant managed-browser runtime is outside the ClawHub source tree, so automation cannot choose the repository boundary or migration policy for maintainers.

options.title: Migrate To Runtime Tracker
options.body: Create or move the report to the OpenClaw runtime/browser tracker and keep this issue only as a cross-link until that canonical item exists.

options.title: Keep As ClawHub Triage
options.body: Leave this issue open in ClawHub as an explicit routing record for maintainers who triage OpenClaw runtime reports from this repository.

options.title: Close After Canonical Link
options.body: Close this issue only after a canonical runtime/browser issue is linked so the reporter's environment and logs remain discoverable.

recommendation.title: Migrate To Runtime Tracker
recommendation.body: Create or move the report to the OpenClaw runtime/browser tracker and keep this issue only as a cross-link until that canonical item exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest ClawHub-side owner from the current docs and CLI boundary history.
